notes: Value part of the LADN indication information element (octet 4 to h): The value part of the LADN indication information element consists of zero or more LADN DNN values. If the LADN indication information element conveys more than 8 LADN DNN values in this information element, the network shall consider the first 8 LADN DNN values and ignore the remaining octets of the information element.
LADN DNN value: LADN DNN value is coded as the length and value part of DNN information element as specified in subclause 9.11.2.1B starting with the second octet.
